desc: Identify that every initially occupied red (blue) box must lie in the permutation cycle of \(X\) under \(P\) (\(Q\)); otherwise the answer is \(-1\).
Recognize that one operation per relevant box may be insufficient because red and blue precedence constraints can form directed cycles.
Derive an exact characterization of repeated box operations and the minimum total number of operations.
Prove that the characterization is both necessary and constructively sufficient, including batching of multiple balls.
Design an \(O(N \log N)\) algorithm and handle zero-ball, initially-\(X\), and infeasible cases.
Write the Python stdin/stdout solution and verify it on all supplied samples.
